Game Overview

Chitu Adventures 2 is a adventure title where navigate a perilous corporate world as Chitu in this thrilling 2D platformer. Leap over bullets, dodge devious coworkers and flying robots, and master each new challenge. As obstacles intensify, strategic movements and perfect timing are key to collecting crucial documents across eight engaging, escalating levels.
